trigger.observation: ALG-018C strongly improves H5 but only marginally improves H10 over the H-blind cached-target control.
trigger.independent_audit: Two independent audits found zero arithmetic or implementation mismatches and identified B=10,H=5 grid parity as the leading explanation.
trigger.question: Does finite-horizon absolute-loss calibration help outside the B=10,H=5 parity cell when budget and future count are crossed on identical Origins?
trigger.claim_limit: All source outcomes and the triggering H5/H10 results are opened. This audit can characterize mechanism only; it cannot independently confirm or nominate a Selector.

research_contract.primary_outcome: Repository-first future pass-rate MAE for the exact cached target configuration.
research_contract.primary_control: For each budget B, the feasible q/B nearest to historical s/n, with lower-q ties.
research_contract.primary_method: ALG-018C-P plug-in Binomial finite-horizon predictive median on the feasible q/B grid.
research_contract.fixed_sensitivity: ALG-018C Jeffreys Beta-Binomial finite-horizon predictive median.
research_contract.matched_frame: The standard non-overlapping H10 frame: 107 Origins in 11 repositories. H5 uses the first five Tasks of the same Origin's ten-Task future block.
required_reports: plugin, Jeffreys, H-blind, and full-history repository-first MAE in every cell
paired plugin-minus-H-blind and Jeffreys-minus-H-blind repository bootstraps and repository directions
leave-one-repository-out direction for every primary contrast
equal-budget random calibration for plugin and H-blind methods
q distributions, changed-action counts, inventory clamps, and plugin-versus-Jeffreys action differences
B10 horizon-swap diagnostic: score the H5 action on H10 and the H10 action on H5
two byte-identical materialization and score executions
insufficient_outcomes: a pooled-cell result that hides cell-specific direction
a gain versus full history without comparison to the same-budget H-blind control
a random midrank used as a p-value or replacement baseline
a claim about unseen Agents, Task content, temporal regimes, latent capability, prospective behavior, or production readiness

information_contract.name: retrospective_cached_exact_configuration_counterfactual
allowed_inputs: target-repository Task identities and projected Task times at or before the Origin cutoff
complete binary official outcomes for the same public model/harness configuration on eligible history
predeclared future Task count H and Selection budget B
information_contract.source_limitation: The Multi-SWE projection has no Result availability timestamp and does not prove the full production Agent fingerprint. The study assumes the same-configuration history was cached by cutoff.
forbidden_inputs: future Task identity, content, attribute, patch, or outcome during action construction
another configuration substituted for missing history

h_blind_control.action: Choose feasible integer q minimizing abs(q*n-B*s), then lower q.
h_blind_control.membership: Choose q newest projected-time successes and B-q newest projected-time failures.

ALG-018C-P.action: With K distributed Binomial(H,s/n), choose feasible q minimizing exact sum_k w_k*abs(H*q-B*k), then distance to s/n, then lower q.
ALG-018C-P.role: canonical KISS grid-aware method for this audit

ALG-018C.action: With K distributed Beta-Binomial(H,s+1/2,n-s+1/2), choose feasible q minimizing the same exact absolute loss, then distance to the Jeffreys predictive mean, then lower q.
ALG-018C.role: fixed sensitivity; cannot replace the primary method from observed cells

frozen_interpretation.general_support: Both equal-grid cells B5_H5 and B10_H10 have plugin-minus-H-blind repository-bootstrap upper bounds below zero.
frozen_interpretation.grid_dominant: B10_H5 has a plugin-minus-H-blind repository-bootstrap upper bound below zero, its absolute aggregate contrast exceeds twice every other cell, and general_support is false.
frozen_interpretation.mixed: Neither general_support nor grid_dominant is true.
frozen_interpretation.horizon_swap: Diagnostic only. It tests whether using the wrong declared H loses to the matched-H action; it cannot promote a method.

random.coupling: One subset per Origin and draw shared across all 36 configurations.

statistical_protocol.multiple_comparisons: The four cells and both fixed methods are reported together. No cell is a confirmatory claim.

claim_boundary: Opened, projected-time, retrospective same-configuration cached-result mechanism characterization. No prospective, Result-availability, full-Agent-identity, unseen-target, Task-content, temporal-regime, latent-capability, sealed-holdout, certification, or production-default claim.
